relationships.subject: chronic constriction injury
relationships.evidence_quote: The peripheral neuropathy promoted the increase in the expression of CB1 and TRPV1 receptors in the anterior cingulate cortex (ACC), anterior insular cortex (AIC), basolateral amygdala (BLA), dorsal hippocampus (DH), and ventral hippocampus (VH).

relationships.subject: cannabidiol
relationships.evidence_quote: CBD potentiated this effect in the ACC, AIC, BLA, DH, and VH regions.

relationships.subject: cannabidiol
relationships.evidence_quote: low doses of CBD were able to (1) reverse mechanical and thermal allodynia (cold) and hyperalgesia

key_findings: Low-dose CBD reverses allodynia, hyperalgesia and anxiety-like behavior in CCI rats.
CCI increases CB1 and TRPV1 in ACC, AIC, BLA and hippocampus, further increased by CBD.
